plan.hypothesis: A low-rank association tensor with explicit rare corrections and an error-bounded exact fallback can accelerate soft-cue association retrieval while preserving every selected answer, including after updates and forgetting.
plan.novelty: Tensor trains, sparse corrections and margin bounds are established methods. This probes their joint behavior; no invention or general memory advantage is asserted.
plan.scope: Generated continuous association weights only; not nearest-neighbor search, natural-language memory utility, held-out qualification or a production implementation.
plan.iterations: All fits infer factors from the observed tensor. Alternate rank-4 TT-SVD and explicit corrections above the fixed threshold eight times. Never supply generator factors to the candidate.
plan.query: Two nonnegative normalized cue vectors contract the first two axes; return the highest-scoring third-axis identity with smallest-ID ties. Small-support queries use the exact gather control. Other queries may return a factorized answer only when the top-two gap exceeds twice a conservative residual-plus-roundoff bound; otherwise evaluate the original tensor.
plan.controls: Exact dense two-stage BLAS contraction and exact indexed gather contraction. Use gather when support product is less than one quarter of the first-two-axis domain. Retain raw input in the candidate for fallback and count it in all memory reports.
plan.mutation: For each case overwrite one association, delete another by setting it to zero, then rebuild from the surviving observed tensor. Verify rebuilt readout and byte-identical state against a separate fresh rebuild. Report rebuild cost; do not present negative delta masking as physical forgetting.
plan.qualityGate: Zero wrong final winners and zero incorrectly certified winners across every case/query and mutation check. Reject nonfinite inputs. Include tiny-gap and exact-tie cases in correctness tests.
plan.promotion: For both correlated and rare-exception scenarios, at every seed and both support64/support128 workloads, candidate median and p95 query times must each be <= half the exact control and at least 90% of queries must avoid fallback. All quality checks must pass. Independent and support4 results stay reported. Passing licenses a native development experiment only.
plan.timing: One warmup per query, then three alternating control/candidate repetitions. Shared-host NumPy timings are exploratory; no milestone 3 or 6 claim. Charge certification and fallback time.
